description: How a client and the engine settle on a protocol version (ADR 0161). The engine serving min..=current welcomes a client that speaks up to `client` at the lower of the two, and refuses one below min (`result` null). A client serving min..=current accepts a welcome at `welcomed` only inside its own range. soyeht_protocol::handshake and the Swift ProtocolVersion pass the same cases.

negotiate.name: a client newer than the engine is welcomed at the engine's version
an older client inside the range
an older client at the top of the range
a client below the floor is refused

welcome.name: an engine older than the client but inside its range
an engine below the client's floor
